title: Floyd–Warshall — all-pairs shortest paths (recognition level)
summary: dist[i][j] = min(dist[i][j], dist[i][k] + dist[k][j]) for every intermediate k. O(n³), n ≤ ~400.

sections.title: Idea
When to use
sections.body: ✍️ Small n (≤ 400), many queries between arbitrary pairs, e.g. "city with the smallest number of neighbours within a threshold" (LeetCode 1334).
